text:
nina: quick idea for metered-to-commit conversions via HW partner rebates + renewal uplift triggers. want to prototype a marketplace private offer that includes a shipment-rebate and a 12mo commit with conversion bonus. thoughts?
oscar: sounds promising. what's the conversion bonus mechanic? immediate credit or applied at renewal?
jamal: finance: need to avoid revenue recognition headaches. prefer rebate as contra-revenue in months 1-3, renewal uplift as separate incentive accrual.
lisa: from partnerships: HW partner ok to co-fund if we promise a trial-to-paid conversion metric (>=40% active usage by day 90) and a marketing joint announcement if >$250k ARR conversion. legal needs 45 days.
nina: ok rule: HW rebate = $2k per validated node shipped (max $50k), applied as invoice credit across first billing cycle. Conversion bonus = 5% credit on next year's commit if conversion metric met.
oscar: sales ops ask: can we make rebate conditional in marketplace UI? e.g., show provisional credit until ship proof uploaded.
billing-bot: automation note: provisional credit flag available, final apply after partner-verified receipt and activation.
jamal: finance note: map HW rebate to rev-credits GL; mark conversion bonus as deferred contract liability until renewal acceptance. run P&L sensitivity table please.
lisa: partner marketing wants a co-branded announcement window of 60 days post-conversion. they want logo usage approval by legal.
oscar: sales worry: if customer churns after rebate, we need clawback. suggest 12-month clawback schedule prorated on remaining commit.
nina: agree. add 12mo prorated recoup if customer terminates or falls below 50% utilization in first 6 months.
jamal: also require minimum contract floor of $100k commit to qualify for HW rebate. avoids small-account losses.
lisa: SI partners: propose $10k implementation credit when SI delivers go-live within 90 days. applies as negative line item on month 2 invoice. conditional on SI report.
billing-bot: action items recorded: 1) draft marketplace PO template with provisional credit state, 2) SKU with three lines: commit, hw-rebate (provisional), si-credit (conditional), 3) billing automation for provisional->final credit, 4) GL mapping and revenue recognition guidance, 5) legal partner CLA & announcement window.
oscar: can we get a quick example payload for marketplace preview? small JSON snippet will help UI team.
nina: sample below, use as mock only: ```{ "term":12, "commit_usd":"120000", "hw_rebate":"$2000_per_node_max_50k", "conversion_metric":"40pct_active_90d", "conversion_bonus":"5pct_next_year_commit", "si_credit":"$10000_on_go_live_within_90d" }```
jamal: finance request: run conservative/expected/upside for conversion rates 25/50/75% please. include churn and clawback scenarios.
lisa: partner legal timeline to confirm by 2026-05-20; if delayed, drop co-brand ask but keep rebate program.
oscar: sales ops will prototype UI banner showing provisional rebate and required docs. ETA EOW.
billing-bot: checklist updated with deadlines: SKU prototype by 2026-05-01, finance models by 2026-05-03, legal signoff attempt by 2026-05-20.
nina: thanks team. I'll schedule 30m sync next Tue to review models and the marketplace mock. keep asks tight so we can pilot with 2 partners first.
